notes.title: The game is about to be changed to a free game! Thank you for your understanding
notes.notes:
1. Why is the game changed to free?
  In order to be consistent with the mobile version, the game is more suitable for free, thinking that the in-game qualifying requires more free players! The rest of the game will not change, including the amount of combat resources.
All cards in the game can be obtained for free, of course, you can also use in-game purchases.
2. When will it be adjusted for free?
Modified to free time is September 30
3. How to compensate current users?
All current users will automatically open "Dragon Tower", "Aquarium Tower", and "Dead Tower"


Thank you very much for your support along the way! Thank you for your understanding!
